note: Beta main has 172 printed entries B001-B171 with two B005 print variants (B005A/B). Six Box Topper entries T001-T006 are local identifiers, not original printed card numbers. Ability and gameplay fields are intentionally null until verified.

cards.name: Adam Smasher: Ender of Legends
cards.abilityEnglish: {Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.) {Play} Defeat a rival Unit.
cards.abilityZh: 【獨闖（Go Solo）】支付這張傳奇角色的費用，將其以重置狀態作為單位打出。本回合可以攻擊；離開戰場時，將其移出遊戲。【打出（Play）】擊敗一個對手單位。
cards.nameZh: 亞當・碎骨：傳奇終結者

cards.name: Dexter DeShawn: Off the Grid
cards.abilityEnglish: {Call} Choose one effect. Give a friendly Unit +2 power this turn. // Draw 1. {Spend}: Increase a Gig by up to 2.
cards.abilityZh: 【呼叫（Call）】選擇一項效果：本回合一個友方單位戰力 +2；或抽 1 張牌。【橫置（Spend）】使一顆任務骰的點數最多提高 2。
cards.nameZh: 德克斯特・德尚：銷聲匿跡

cards.name: Johnny Silverhand: Rocking Renegade
cards.abilityEnglish: 2 €$, {Spend} A friendly Unit can attack spent rival Units the turn it's played. If it's a ROCKER Unit, also give it +2 power this turn. This effect costs -1 €$ for each friendly Gig with 8+ value.
cards.abilityZh: 支付 2 歐元並【橫置】：一個友方單位在打出的當回合，可以攻擊已橫置的對手單位。如果該單位具有「搖滾客（ROCKER）」類別，本回合戰力再 +2。你每控制一顆點數為 8 以上的友方任務骰，此能力的費用便減少 1 歐元。

cards.name: Royce: Psycho on the Edge
cards.abilityEnglish: {Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.) During your turn, this Legend has +2 power for each of its equipped Gear.
cards.abilityZh: 【獨闖（Go Solo）】支付這張傳奇角色的費用，將其以重置狀態作為單位打出。本回合可以攻擊；離開戰場時，將其移出遊戲。在你的回合中，此傳奇角色每裝備一張裝備卡，戰力便 +2。

cards.name: V: Streetkid
cards.abilityEnglish: {Call} Trash 3. Then, add 1 BRAINDANCE Program from your trash to your hand. {Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.)
cards.abilityZh: 【呼叫（Call）】將牌庫頂的 3 張牌置入棄牌區，然後從自己的棄牌區選擇 1 張具有「幻舞（BRAINDANCE）」類別的程式牌加入手牌。【獨闖（Go Solo）】支付這張傳奇角色的費用，將其以重置狀態作為單位打出。本回合可以攻擊；離開戰場時，將其移出遊戲。

cards.name: V: Streetkid
cards.abilityEnglish: {Call} Trash 3. Then, add 1 BRAINDANCE Program from your trash to your hand. {Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.)
cards.abilityZh: 【呼叫（Call）】將牌庫頂的 3 張牌置入棄牌區，然後從自己的棄牌區選擇 1 張具有「幻舞（BRAINDANCE）」類別的程式牌加入手牌。【獨闖（Go Solo）】支付這張傳奇角色的費用，將其以重置狀態作為單位打出。本回合可以攻擊；離開戰場時，將其移出遊戲。

cards.name: 6th Street Recruits
cards.abilityEnglish: When a friendly Unit steals a d6, increase a Gig by up to 6.
cards.abilityZh: 每當一個友方單位奪取一顆六面任務骰（d6），使一顆任務骰的點數最多提高 6。

cards.name: Animals Wrecker
cards.abilityEnglish: [Flavour Text] Takes a lot of juice to break bones like they do.
cards.abilityZh: 無額外卡牌能力。（風味文字：要像他們一樣粉碎骨頭，可得消耗不少能量。）

cards.name: Chrome Fang
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} Until your next turn, rival Units can't steal friendly Gigs with value higher than their power.
cards.abilityZh: 【打出（Play）】直到你的下一回合開始之前，對手單位無法奪取點數高於其戰力的友方任務骰。

cards.name: El Sombrerón: La Venganza Lenta
cards.abilityEnglish: {Attack} You may pay 2 €$. If you do, this Unit gains power equal to a friendly max Gig this turn.
cards.abilityZh: 【攻擊（Attack）】你可以支付 2 歐元。若如此做，本回合此單位獲得的額外戰力，等同於你控制的一顆最大點數任務骰的點數。

cards.name: Japantown Jonin
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} Give a friendly Unit +2 power this turn. (Units with power 0 don't steal Gigs.)
cards.abilityZh: 【打出（Play）】本回合使一個友方單位戰力 +2。（戰力為 0 的單位無法奪取任務骰。）

cards.name: Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting
cards.abilityEnglish: The first time this Unit wins a fight each turn, ready it. This Unit wins all fights against CORPO Units.
cards.abilityZh: 每回合此單位第一次贏得戰鬥時，將其重置。此單位與具有「企業人員（CORPO）」類別的單位戰鬥時，必定獲勝。
cards.nameZh: 銀手強尼：戰鬥永不止息

cards.name: Kerry Eurodyne: The Last Rockerboy
cards.abilityEnglish: {Spend} If you control a Gig with 8+ value, draw 2.
cards.abilityZh: 【橫置（Spend）】如果你控制至少一顆點數為 8 以上的任務骰，抽 2 張牌。
cards.nameZh: 凱瑞・歐羅迪恩：最後的搖滾客

cards.name: La Llorona: Ghost of the Past
cards.abilityEnglish: {Blocker} (You may spend this Unit to redirect a rival Unit's attack to it instead.) When this Unit uses {Blocker}, increase a Gig by up to 3.
cards.abilityZh: 【阻擋（Blocker）】你可以將此單位橫置，改由它承受對手單位的攻擊。每當此單位使用【阻擋】，使一顆任務骰的點數最多提高 3。

cards.name: Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo
cards.abilityEnglish: {Blocker} This Unit has +2 power while fighting a Legend. When a Rival adjusts or swaps 1 or more friendly Gigs, you may add a card from your trash to your hand.
cards.abilityZh: 【阻擋（Blocker）】此單位與傳奇角色戰鬥時，戰力 +2。每當對手調整或交換一顆以上的友方任務骰時，你可以從自己的棄牌區選擇一張卡加入手牌。
cards.nameZh: 梅若迪絲・史陶特：冷酷企業人

cards.name: Octant
cards.abilityEnglish: Play this Unit for -1 €$ for each friendly Gig with 8+ value, to a minimum of 1 €$.
cards.abilityZh: 你每控制一顆點數為 8 以上的友方任務骰，打出此單位的費用便減少 1 歐元，最低為 1 歐元。

cards.name: Royce: Don't Call Me Simon
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} Defeat a rival Unit with power 2 or less. If you have more ☆ (Street Cred) than a Rival, defeat a rival Unit with power 3 or less instead.
cards.abilityZh: 【打出（Play）】擊敗一個戰力 2 以下的對手單位。如果你的街頭聲望高於對手，改為擊敗一個戰力 3 以下的對手單位。

cards.name: Ruthless Lowlife
cards.abilityEnglish: This Unit can only attack rival Units. (It can't attack Gig areas.)
cards.abilityZh: 此單位只能攻擊對手單位。（無法攻擊任務骰區。）

cards.name: Screw: Lovelorn Fool
cards.abilityEnglish: {Defeated} Add another Unit from your trash to your hand.
cards.abilityZh: 【被擊敗（Defeated）】從自己的棄牌區選擇另一張單位牌加入手牌。
cards.nameZh: 史克魯：為愛所困的傻瓜

cards.name: Swordwise Huscle
cards.abilityEnglish: {Attack} If this Unit has power 5+, draw 1.
cards.abilityZh: 【攻擊（Attack）】如果此單位戰力為 5 以上，抽 1 張牌。

cards.name: V: Roamer of the Badlands
cards.abilityEnglish: When this Unit steals a Gig, increase it by up to 5. At the end of your turn, if you control 2 or more Gigs with 8+ value, draw 1.
cards.abilityZh: 每當此單位奪取一顆任務骰時，使該任務骰點數最多提高 5。在你的回合結束時，如果你控制至少兩顆點數為 8 以上的任務骰，抽 1 張牌。

cards.name: Valentino Guerrera
cards.abilityEnglish: If you have more ☆ (Street Cred) than a Rival, this Unit can attack ready Units with {Blocker}.
cards.abilityZh: 如果你的街頭聲望高於對手，此單位可以攻擊具有【阻擋（Blocker）】能力且處於重置狀態的單位。

cards.name: Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} You may play a Unit with cost 4 or less from your hand or trash for free. It can attack rival Units this turn. The first time an ARASAKA Unit is defeated each turn, draw 1.
cards.abilityZh: 【打出（Play）】你可以從手牌或棄牌區免費打出一張費用 4 以下的單位牌；該單位本回合可以攻擊對手單位。每回合第一次有「荒坂（ARASAKA）」單位被擊敗時，抽 1 張牌。

cards.name: Arasaka Emergency Radioport
cards.abilityEnglish: (Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.) When this Unit or Legend is spent, you may look at a friendly face-down Legend. If that Legend is ARASAKA or has {Go Solo}, you may Call it for free. (You may only Call a Legend once per turn.)
cards.abilityZh: （裝備給友方單位或正面朝上的傳奇角色。）每當裝備此卡的單位或傳奇角色橫置時，你可以查看自己一張背面朝上的傳奇角色。如果該角色具有「荒坂（ARASAKA）」類別或【獨闖（Go Solo）】能力，你可以免費呼叫該角色。（每回合只能呼叫一名傳奇角色。）

cards.name: Deadman Transmitter
cards.abilityEnglish: (Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.) If this Unit would be defeated, defeat its "DEADMAN TRANSMITTER" instead.
cards.abilityZh: （裝備給友方單位或正面朝上的傳奇角色。）如果裝備此卡的單位即將被擊敗，改為擊敗裝備在該單位上的「死亡訊號發射器」。

cards.name: Mantis Blades
cards.abilityEnglish: (Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.) "One cut, one kill."
cards.abilityZh: （裝備給友方單位或正面朝上的傳奇角色。）無額外規則能力。（風味文字：「一刀，一命。」）

cards.name: Satori: Sword of Saburo
cards.abilityEnglish: (Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.) When this Unit wins a fight against a rival Unit, draw 1.
cards.abilityZh: （裝備給友方單位或正面朝上的傳奇角色。）每當裝備此卡的單位贏得與對手單位的戰鬥時，抽 1 張牌。

cards.name: All is Lost
cards.abilityEnglish: Trash 3. Add a Unit from among them to your hand.
cards.abilityZh: 將牌庫頂的 3 張牌置入棄牌區。從這些牌中選擇一張單位牌加入手牌。

cards.name: Appetite for Destruction
cards.abilityEnglish: The next time a friendly Unit wins a fight by 3+ power this turn, it also steals a Gig.
cards.abilityZh: 本回合下一次有友方單位以至少高出對手 3 點的戰力贏得戰鬥時，該單位也會奪取一顆任務骰。

cards.name: Bonnie and Clyde
cards.abilityEnglish: Defeat a rival Unit with power 4 or less. You may defeat 2 instead if a Rival controls at least 2 Gigs more than you.
cards.abilityZh: 擊敗一個戰力 4 以下的對手單位。如果對手控制的任務骰數量比你至少多 2 顆，你可以改為擊敗兩個符合條件的單位。

cards.name: Carnage at the Colosseum
cards.abilityEnglish: Play this Program for -1 €$ for each friendly Gig with 8+ value, to a minimum of 1 €$. Defeat a rival Unit with less power than a friendly Unit.
cards.abilityZh: 你每控制一顆點數為 8 以上的友方任務骰，打出此程式牌的費用便減少 1 歐元，最低為 1 歐元。擊敗一個戰力低於某個友方單位的對手單位。

cards.name: Detonate
cards.abilityEnglish: {Quick} Defeat a rival Gear with power 2 or less.
cards.abilityZh: 【快速（Quick）】擊敗一張戰力 2 以下的對手裝備牌。

cards.name: Gunpoint Diplomacy
cards.abilityEnglish: Give a friendly Unit these effects. If you have less ☆ (Street Cred) than a Rival, they instead choose one effect for you. The next time this Unit attacks this turn, it may attack ready Units. // Give this Unit +3 power this turn.
cards.abilityZh: 讓一個友方單位獲得下列兩項效果。如果你的街頭聲望低於對手，則改由對手為你選擇其中一項：① 該單位本回合下一次攻擊時，可以攻擊處於重置狀態的單位；② 本回合該單位戰力 +3。

cards.name: Industrial Assembly
cards.abilityEnglish: Increase a Gig by up to 4. If you control a Gig with 8+ value, draw 1.
cards.abilityZh: 使一顆任務骰的點數最多提高 4。如果你控制一顆點數為 8 以上的任務骰，抽 1 張牌。

cards.name: Over the Edge
cards.abilityEnglish: Defeat a Unit with power equal to or less than the value of a friendly d20.
cards.abilityZh: 擊敗一個戰力不高於你控制的一顆友方二十面任務骰（d20）點數的單位。

cards.name: Shattered Memories
cards.abilityEnglish: Each player discards their hand and may draw 5. If the total number of discarded cards equals the value of a friendly Gig, draw 2.
cards.abilityZh: 雙方玩家各自棄掉所有手牌，然後可以各抽 5 張牌。如果這次棄掉的牌張數總和，等於你控制的一顆友方任務骰的點數，你再抽 2 張牌。

cards.name: Dum Dum: Maelstrom Triggerman
cards.abilityEnglish: {Call} You may defeat a friendly Gear. If you do, draw 2. Otherwise, draw 1. {Quick} 1 €$, {Spend} Give a friendly Unit +1 power this turn for each of its equipped Gear.
cards.abilityZh: 【呼叫（Call）】你可以擊敗一張友方裝備牌。若如此做，抽 2 張牌；否則抽 1 張牌。【快速（Quick）】支付 1 歐元並【橫置（Spend）】：本回合一個友方單位每裝備一張裝備牌，戰力便 +1。

cards.name: Kerry Eurodyne: Axe, Attitude, Audience
cards.abilityEnglish: When you roll in a Gig from your fixer area, you may ignore the result and reroll it once. When you roll a min or max value on a Gig, draw 1. If it's a d20, draw 3 instead.
cards.abilityZh: 每當你從合事佬區擲入一顆任務骰時，可以忽略結果並重新擲骰一次。每當你擲出一顆任務骰的最小或最大點數時，抽 1 張牌；如果那是二十面骰（d20），則改為抽 3 張。
cards.nameZh: 凱瑞・歐羅迪恩：吉他、態度、觀眾

cards.name: Muamar Reyes: El Capitán
cards.abilityEnglish: {Call} Choose one effect. A friendly Unit can't be defeated in a fight this turn. // Draw 1. {Spend} Adjust a Gig by 1.
cards.abilityZh: 【呼叫（Call）】選擇一項效果：本回合一個友方單位不會在戰鬥中被擊敗；或抽 1 張牌。【橫置（Spend）】將一顆任務骰的點數調整 1。

cards.name: River Ward: Detective on the Hunt
cards.abilityEnglish: {Quick} {Spend} Play a Gear with cost 2 or less from your hand for free. When a friendly equipped Unit is defeated, search the top 2 cards of your deck and trash 1.
cards.abilityZh: 【快速（Quick）】【橫置（Spend）】從手牌免費打出一張費用 2 以下的裝備牌。每當一個裝備了裝備牌的友方單位被擊敗時，查看牌庫頂的 2 張牌，並將其中 1 張置入棄牌區。
cards.nameZh: 大河・瓦德：追查中的警探

cards.name: Rogue Amendiares: Preem Solo
cards.abilityEnglish: {Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.) When a friendly Legend steals a Gig, if its value is even, draw 1. If its value is odd, a Rival discards 1.
cards.abilityZh: 【獨闖（Go Solo）】支付此傳奇角色的費用，將其作為重置狀態的單位打出。本回合可以攻擊；離開戰場時將其移出遊戲。每當友方傳奇角色奪取任務骰時，若該骰點數為偶數，抽 1 張牌；若為奇數，則一名對手棄 1 張牌。
cards.nameZh: 若惡・阿曼迪亞蕾絲：頂尖獨武俠

cards.name: Adam Smasher: Metal Over Meat
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} Defeat all other Units.
cards.abilityZh: 【打出（Play）】擊敗場上所有其他單位。
cards.nameZh: 亞當・碎骨：鋼鐵凌駕血肉

cards.name: Alt Cunningham: Mother of Daemons
cards.abilityEnglish: When a friendly equipped Unit or Legend is spent, draw 1. When a rival Unit would steal a Gig, you may discard 1 with cost equal to that Gig's value. If you do, the Gig isn't stolen.
cards.abilityZh: 每當一個已裝備的友方單位或傳奇角色橫置時，抽 1 張牌。當對手單位即將奪取任務骰時，你可以棄掉 1 張費用等於該骰點數的牌。若如此做，該任務骰便不會被奪取。
cards.nameZh: 艾特・坎寧安：魔偶之母

cards.name: Augmented Negotiators
cards.abilityEnglish: {Blocker} (You may spend this Unit to redirect a rival Unit's attack to it instead.) When this Unit uses {Blocker}, a Rival discards 1.
cards.abilityZh: 【阻擋（Blocker）】你可以橫置此單位，改由其承受對手單位的攻擊。每當此單位使用【阻擋】，一名對手棄 1 張牌。

cards.name: Caliber: Totentanz's Top Dog
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} Defeat a rival Unit with cost 2 or less. {Defeated} A Rival discards 1. If the card's cost equals the value of a friendly Gig, that Rival discards 1 more.
cards.abilityZh: 【打出（Play）】擊敗一個費用為 2 以下的對手單位。【被擊敗（Defeated）】一名對手棄 1 張牌。如果棄掉的牌費用等於某顆友方任務骰的點數，該對手再棄 1 張牌。
cards.nameZh: 卡利柏：死亡之舞的頭號打手

cards.name: Gilded Matón
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} You may defeat a friendly Gear. If you do, defeat a rival Unit with cost 3 or less.
cards.abilityZh: 【打出（Play）】你可以擊敗一張友方裝備牌。若如此做，擊敗一個費用為 3 以下的對手單位。

cards.name: Hanako Arasaka: In a Gilded Cage
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} Search the top 4 cards of your deck. Reveal any number of cards with cost equal to any friendly Gig values and add them to your hand. Bottom-deck the rest.
cards.abilityZh: 【打出（Play）】查看牌庫頂的 4 張牌。你可以展示任意張費用等於某顆友方任務骰點數的牌，並將它們加入手牌。其餘置於牌庫底。

cards.name: Heywood Ripperdoc
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} You may defeat a Gear. If its cost equals the value of a friendly Gig, draw 1.
cards.abilityZh: 【打出（Play）】你可以擊敗一張裝備牌。如果該裝備牌的費用等於某顆友方任務骰的點數，抽 1 張牌。

cards.name: Jackie Welles: Ride or Die Choom
cards.abilityEnglish: {Attack} Give this Unit +2 power this turn for each friendly Gig with an even value. {Defeated} Draw 1 for each friendly Gig with an odd value.
cards.abilityZh: 【攻擊（Attack）】你每控制一顆點數為偶數的友方任務骰，本回合此單位戰力便 +2。【被擊敗（Defeated）】你每控制一顆點數為奇數的友方任務骰，抽 1 張牌。
cards.nameZh: 阿傑・威爾斯：生死與共的兄弟

cards.name: Maelstrom Goons
cards.abilityEnglish: When this Unit steals a Gig, if it's equipped, a Rival discards 1.
cards.abilityZh: 每當此單位奪取任務骰時，若它已裝備裝備牌，一名對手棄 1 張牌。

cards.name: MaxTac Suppression Team
cards.abilityEnglish: Rival Units can't attack the turn they're played.
cards.abilityZh: 對手單位不能在打出的當回合攻擊。

cards.name: Offduty Malfini
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} Spend this Unit and a rival Unit.
cards.abilityZh: 【打出（Play）】橫置此單位及一個對手單位。

cards.name: Rockn' Rockerboy
cards.abilityEnglish: [Flavor] Scream your throat raw for something. Anything.
cards.abilityZh: 無額外規則能力。（風味文字：為了某件事，無論是什麼，都要吶喊到聲嘶力竭。）

cards.name: Secondhand Bombus
cards.abilityEnglish: {Blocker} (You may spend this Unit to redirect a rival Unit's attack to it instead.) (Units with power 0 don't steal Gigs.)
cards.abilityZh: 【阻擋（Blocker）】你可以橫置此單位，改由其承受對手單位的攻擊。（戰力為 0 的單位無法奪取任務骰。）

cards.name: Sketchy Ripper
cards.abilityEnglish: {Attack} Search the top 3 cards of your deck. Reveal a Gear and add it to your hand. Bottom-deck the rest. (Units with power 0 don't steal Gigs.)

cards.name: Mandibular Upgrade

cards.name: Zetatech Faceplate

cards.name: Afterparty at Lizzie's

cards.abilityZh: 使一顆任務骰的點數最多調整 1。如果你控制至少 2 顆點數不同的任務骰，抽 1 張牌。

cards.name: Bootleg Black Sapphire Show

cards.name: Cyberpsychosis
cards.abilityEnglish: {Quick} Give an equipped Unit +3 power this turn for each of its equipped Gears. If that Unit steals or fights, defeat it at the end of this turn.

cards.name: Live with the Aftermath

cards.name: Goro Takemura: Vengeful Bodyguard

cards.name: Hanako Arasaka: Daughter of the Emperor

cards.name: Jackie Welles: Mama's Favorite

cards.abilityZh: 【獨闖（Go Solo）】支付此傳奇角色的費用，將其作為重置狀態的單位打出。本回合可以攻擊；離開戰場時將其移出遊戲。當一個友方單位即將被擊敗時，你可以支付 1 €$，改為擊敗此傳奇角色。（將其移出遊戲。）

cards.name: Evelyn Parker: Scheming Siren
cards.abilityEnglish: {Attack} Draw 1. Then, if you have more Street Cred than a Rival, discard 1. (Units with power 0 don't steal Gigs.)
cards.abilityZh: 【攻擊】抽 1 張牌。然後，若你的街頭聲望高於對手，棄掉 1 張手牌。（戰力為 0 的單位無法奪取任務。）
cards.nameZh: 伊芙琳・帕克：心機魅影

cards.name: Hacked Corpo
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} Trash 3. Add a Program from among them to your hand.
cards.abilityZh: 【打出】將牌庫頂端 3 張牌棄置，並從其中選擇 1 張程式加入手牌。

cards.name: Jacked-In Voodoo Boy
cards.abilityEnglish: This Unit can't attack unless you played a Program this turn.
cards.abilityZh: 除非你在本回合打出過程式，否則此單位無法攻擊。

cards.name: Judy Álvarez: Nothing to Doubt
cards.abilityEnglish: 1 €$, {Spend} Reveal the top card of your deck. You may play it for free. Otherwise, add it to your hand.
cards.abilityZh: 支付 1 €$ 並【耗用】：展示牌庫頂端的 1 張牌。你可以免費打出該牌；若不打出，則將其加入手牌。
cards.nameZh: 茱蒂・艾法瑞茲：無庸置疑

cards.name: Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} You may play a Program with cost 3 or less from your hand or trash for free. Bottom-deck it after you play it. {Blocker}
cards.abilityZh:
【打出】你可以從手牌或棄牌區免費打出 1 張費用為 3 或以下的程式。打出該程式後，將其置於牌庫底部。
【阻擋者】

cards.name: Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} You may discard 2 Programs. If you do, bottom-deck a rival unequipped Unit.
cards.abilityZh: 【打出】你可以棄掉 2 張程式牌。若如此做，將 1 個未裝備任何裝備的對手單位放到其牌庫底部。

cards.name: Misty Olszewski: Mender of Broken Spirits
cards.abilityEnglish: This Unit can't attack. At the end of your turn, choose a card type. Then, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's the chosen type, add it to your hand and ready 1 Eddie. Otherwise, trash it. (Unit, Gear, and Program are card types.)
cards.abilityZh: 此單位無法攻擊。在你的回合結束時，選擇一種卡牌類型，然後展示牌庫頂端的 1 張牌。若該牌屬於所選類型，將其加入手牌並重置 1 枚歐元籌碼；否則將其棄置。（單位、裝備與程式皆為卡牌類型。）
cards.nameZh: 迷霧・奧爾謝夫斯基：療癒破碎心靈

cards.name: Modded Kusanagi
cards.abilityEnglish: {Adrenaline} (This Unit can attack the turn it's played.) At the end of your turn, return this Unit to its owner's hand.
cards.abilityZh: 【腎上腺素】此單位在打出的當回合便可攻擊。回合結束時將其返回持有者手牌。

cards.name: Modded Muramasa
cards.abilityEnglish: At the end of your turn, if you have less Street Cred than a Rival, ready this Unit.
cards.abilityZh: 回合結束時，若你的街頭聲望低於對手，重置此單位。

cards.name: Mox Inciters
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} A rival Unit must attack next turn if it can. {Blocker} (You may spend this Unit to redirect a rival Unit's attack to it instead.)
cards.abilityZh: 【打出】一個對手單位在下回合若能攻擊，就必須攻擊。【阻擋者】可以耗用此單位，將對手單位的攻擊轉向此單位。

cards.name: Placide: Voodoo Sentinel
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} {Attack} You may discard 1 Program. If you do, bottom-deck a rival Unit.
cards.abilityZh: 【打出】【攻擊】可以棄掉一張程式。若如此做，將一個對手單位放到其牌庫底部。

cards.name: Psycho Squad
cards.abilityEnglish: [Flavour] Their protocol stops at “shoot first.”
cards.abilityZh: （風味文字）他們的行動守則只有「先開槍再說」。

cards.name: Rita Wheeler: No Stupid Questions
cards.abilityEnglish: {Blocker} (You may spend this Unit to redirect a rival Unit's attack to it instead.) The first time this Unit is spent each turn, draw 1, then discard 1.
cards.abilityZh: 【阻擋者】可以耗用此單位，將對手單位的攻擊轉向此單位。每回合第一次耗用此單位時，抽一張牌，再棄一張牌。
cards.nameZh: 麗塔・惠勒：沒有蠢問題

cards.name: Rogue Amendiares: Queen of the Afterlife
cards.abilityEnglish: The first time another friendly Unit steals a Gig with value less than its power each turn, ready 2 Eddies. {Quick} 2 €$, {Spend} A rival Unit loses power equal to this Unit's power this turn.
cards.abilityZh: 每回合第一次有另一個我方單位奪取數值低於其戰力的任務時，重置兩枚歐元籌碼。【快速】支付 2 €$ 並【耗用】：本回合使一個對手單位的戰力減少等同此單位戰力的數值。
cards.nameZh: 若惡・阿曼迪亞蕾絲：來生女王

cards.name: Westbrook Netrunner
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} Until your next turn, rival Legends can't steal friendly Gigs with value less than their power.
cards.abilityZh: 【打出】直到你的下個回合，對手傳奇角色無法奪取數值低於其戰力的我方任務。

cards.name: Dying Night: V's Pistol
cards.abilityEnglish: (Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.) {Attack} Decrease a Gig by up to 2. At the end of your turn, if this Unit is named "V", ready 2 Eddies.
cards.abilityZh: （裝備至我方單位或正面朝上的傳奇角色。）【攻擊】使一個任務的數值降低最多 2。回合結束時，若裝備此卡的單位名稱為 V，重置兩枚歐元籌碼。

cards.name: NetWatch Netdriver
cards.abilityEnglish: (Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.) When this Unit or Legend is spent, draw 1.
cards.abilityZh: （裝備至我方單位或正面朝上的傳奇角色。）裝備此卡的單位或傳奇角色被耗用時，抽一張牌。

cards.name: Tetratronic Rippler
cards.abilityEnglish: (Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.) When this Unit or Legend is spent, search the top card of your deck. You may trash it. (Otherwise, keep it on the top of your deck.)
cards.abilityZh: （裝備至我方單位或正面朝上的傳奇角色。）裝備此卡的單位或傳奇角色被耗用時，查看牌庫頂一張牌。你可以將其棄置，否則留在牌庫頂。

cards.name: Chrome Reverie
cards.abilityEnglish: A rival Unit can't attack until your next turn. If you control a min Gig, you may Call a Legend for free. (You can only Call a Legend once per turn.)
cards.abilityZh: 一個對手單位直到你的下個回合前都無法攻擊。若你控制最低數值任務，可以免費呼叫一名傳奇角色。（每回合只能呼叫一次。）

cards.name: Floor It
cards.abilityEnglish: {Quick} Give a rival Unit -1 power this turn. Draw 1.
cards.abilityZh: 【快速】本回合使一個對手單位戰力 -1。抽一張牌。

cards.name: Les Élémens
cards.abilityEnglish: Bottom-deck a Rival's lowest-power Unit. (If there are multiple, choose 1.)
cards.abilityZh: 將對手戰力最低的一個單位放到其牌庫底部。（若並列，選擇其中一個。）

cards.name: Nocturne OP55 N1
cards.abilityEnglish: If your fixer area is empty, play this Program for 1 €$. Choose one effect. Draw 2. // A Unit can't attack until your next turn. // A friendly Legend may use {Go Solo} for -2 €$ this turn, to a minimum of 1 €$.
cards.abilityZh: 若你的合事佬區為空，打出此程式只需 1 €$。選擇一項：抽兩張牌；使一個單位直到你的下個回合前無法攻擊；或本回合一名我方傳奇角色使用【獨闖】的費用減少 2 €$，最低 1 €$。

cards.name: Pyramid Song
cards.abilityEnglish: Choose one effect. If a friendly d4 is a min Gig, choose both instead. Give a rival Unit -4 power this turn. // Bottom-deck a rival Unit with power 0.
cards.abilityZh: 選擇一項；若我方四面骰是最低數值任務，改為兩項都選：本回合一個對手單位戰力 -4；或將一個戰力為 0 的對手單位放到其牌庫底部。

cards.name: Reboot Optics
cards.abilityEnglish: {Quick} The next time a rival Unit fights this turn, it doesn't defeat the opposing friendly Unit.
cards.abilityZh: 【快速】本回合下一次對手單位戰鬥時，不會擊敗與其交戰的我方單位。

cards.name: Three Mouths, One Desire
cards.abilityEnglish: Search the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 to your hand. You may add 1 more for each friendly min Gig. Bottom-deck the rest.
cards.abilityZh: 查看牌庫頂三張牌，將其中一張加入手牌。我方每有一個最低數值任務，可以額外加入一張。其餘放到牌庫底部。

cards.name: Towerfall
cards.abilityEnglish: Choose one effect. If you have less Street Cred than a Rival, choose both instead. Give all rival Units -5 power this turn. // Bottom-deck all rival Units with power 0.
cards.abilityZh: 選擇一項；若你的街頭聲望低於對手，改為兩項都選：本回合所有對手單位戰力 -5；或將所有戰力為 0 的對手單位放到其牌庫底部。

cards.name: Trust No One
cards.abilityEnglish: Decrease a Gig by up to 3. Then, if you control a min Gig, draw 1.
cards.abilityZh: 使一個任務的數值降低最多 3。若你控制最低數值任務，抽一張牌。

cards.name: Unlikely Bond
cards.abilityEnglish: Bottom-deck a ready friendly Unit. If you do, bottom-deck a spent rival Unit.
cards.abilityZh: 將一個重置狀態的我方單位放到其牌庫底部。若如此做，將一個已耗用的對手單位放到其牌庫底部。

cards.name: Adam Smasher: Ender of Legends
cards.abilityEnglish: {Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.) {Play} Defeat a rival Unit.
cards.abilityZh: 【獨闖（Go Solo）】支付這張傳奇角色的費用，將其以重置狀態作為單位打出。本回合可以攻擊；離開戰場時，將其移出遊戲。【打出（Play）】擊敗一個對手單位。
cards.nameZh: 亞當・碎骨：傳奇終結者

cards.name: Dexter DeShawn: Off the Grid
cards.abilityEnglish: {Call} Choose one effect. Give a friendly Unit +2 power this turn. // Draw 1. {Spend}: Increase a Gig by up to 2.
cards.abilityZh: 【呼叫（Call）】選擇一項效果：本回合一個友方單位戰力 +2；或抽 1 張牌。【橫置（Spend）】使一顆任務骰的點數最多提高 2。
cards.nameZh: 德克斯特・德尚：銷聲匿跡

cards.name: Royce: Psycho on the Edge
cards.abilityEnglish: {Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.) During your turn, this Legend has +2 power for each of its equipped Gear.
cards.abilityZh: 【獨闖（Go Solo）】支付這張傳奇角色的費用，將其以重置狀態作為單位打出。本回合可以攻擊；離開戰場時，將其移出遊戲。在你的回合中，此傳奇角色每裝備一張裝備卡，戰力便 +2。

cards.name: V: Streetkid
cards.abilityEnglish: {Call} Trash 3. Then, add 1 BRAINDANCE Program from your trash to your hand. {Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.)
cards.abilityZh: 【呼叫（Call）】將牌庫頂的 3 張牌置入棄牌區，然後從自己的棄牌區選擇 1 張具有「幻舞（BRAINDANCE）」類別的程式牌加入手牌。【獨闖（Go Solo）】支付這張傳奇角色的費用，將其以重置狀態作為單位打出。本回合可以攻擊；離開戰場時，將其移出遊戲。

cards.name: Dum Dum: Maelstrom Triggerman
cards.abilityEnglish: {Call} You may defeat a friendly Gear. If you do, draw 2. Otherwise, draw 1. {Quick} 1 €$, {Spend} Give a friendly Unit +1 power this turn for each of its equipped Gear.
cards.abilityZh: 【呼叫（Call）】你可以擊敗一張友方裝備牌。若如此做，抽 2 張牌；否則抽 1 張牌。【快速（Quick）】支付 1 歐元並【橫置（Spend）】：本回合一個友方單位每裝備一張裝備牌，戰力便 +1。

cards.name: Kerry Eurodyne: Axe, Attitude, Audience
cards.abilityEnglish: When you roll in a Gig from your fixer area, you may ignore the result and reroll it once. When you roll a min or max value on a Gig, draw 1. If it's a d20, draw 3 instead.
cards.abilityZh: 每當你從合事佬區擲入一顆任務骰時，可以忽略結果並重新擲骰一次。每當你擲出一顆任務骰的最小或最大點數時，抽 1 張牌；如果那是二十面骰（d20），則改為抽 3 張。
cards.nameZh: 凱瑞・歐羅迪恩：吉他、態度、觀眾

cards.name: Muamar Reyes: El Capitán
cards.abilityEnglish: {Call} Choose one effect. A friendly Unit can't be defeated in a fight this turn. // Draw 1. {Spend} Adjust a Gig by 1.
cards.abilityZh: 【呼叫（Call）】選擇一項效果：本回合一個友方單位不會在戰鬥中被擊敗；或抽 1 張牌。【橫置（Spend）】將一顆任務骰的點數調整 1。

cards.name: River Ward: Detective on the Hunt
cards.abilityEnglish: {Quick} {Spend} Play a Gear with cost 2 or less from your hand for free. When a friendly equipped Unit is defeated, search the top 2 cards of your deck and trash 1.
cards.abilityZh: 【快速（Quick）】【橫置（Spend）】從手牌免費打出一張費用 2 以下的裝備牌。每當一個裝備了裝備牌的友方單位被擊敗時，查看牌庫頂的 2 張牌，並將其中 1 張置入棄牌區。
cards.nameZh: 大河・瓦德：追查中的警探

cards.name: Rogue Amendiares: Preem Solo
cards.abilityEnglish: {Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.) When a friendly Legend steals a Gig, if its value is even, draw 1. If its value is odd, a Rival discards 1.
cards.abilityZh: 【獨闖（Go Solo）】支付此傳奇角色的費用，將其作為重置狀態的單位打出。本回合可以攻擊；離開戰場時將其移出遊戲。每當友方傳奇角色奪取任務骰時，若該骰點數為偶數，抽 1 張牌；若為奇數，則一名對手棄 1 張牌。
cards.nameZh: 若惡・阿曼迪亞蕾絲：頂尖獨武俠

cards.name: Goro Takemura: Vengeful Bodyguard
cards.abilityEnglish: {Quick} 1 €$, {Spend} Give a friendly Unit with cost 4 or less {Blocker} this turn. If you control a value-pair of Gigs, also give it +1 power this turn. When a friendly Unit uses {Blocker}, you may discard 1. If you do, draw 1.
cards.abilityZh: 【快速（Quick）】支付 1 €$ 並【橫置（Spend）】：使一個費用為 4 以下的友方單位在本回合獲得【阻擋（Blocker）】。若你控制一對點數相同的任務骰，該單位本回合戰力也 +1。每當友方單位使用【阻擋】時，你可以棄 1 張牌；若如此做，抽 1 張牌。

cards.name: Hanako Arasaka: Daughter of the Emperor
cards.abilityEnglish: {Spend} Swap a friendly Gig with a rival Gig. At the start of your turn, draw 1 for each friendly value-pair of Gigs.
cards.abilityZh: 【橫置（Spend）】交換一顆友方任務骰與一顆對手任務骰。你的回合開始時，你每控制一對點數相同的友方任務骰，抽 1 張牌。

cards.name: Jackie Welles: Mama's Favorite
cards.abilityEnglish: {Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.) If a friendly Unit would be defeated, you may pay 1 €$ to defeat this Legend instead. (Remove it from the game.)
cards.abilityZh: 【獨闖（Go Solo）】支付此傳奇角色的費用，將其作為重置狀態的單位打出。本回合可以攻擊；離開戰場時將其移出遊戲。當一個友方單位即將被擊敗時，你可以支付 1 €$，改為擊敗此傳奇角色。（將其移出遊戲。）
cards.nameZh: 阿傑・威爾斯：媽媽的心頭肉

cards.name: Padre: Man of the Cross
cards.abilityEnglish: {Call} Choose one effect. Spend a rival Unit. // Draw 1. {Spend} Set a player's Gig to the same value as another player's Gig.
cards.abilityZh: 【呼叫（Call）】選擇一項效果：橫置一個對手單位；或抽 1 張牌。【橫置（Spend）】將一名玩家控制的一顆任務骰點數，設定為另一名玩家所控制的一顆任務骰的點數。

cards.name: Panam Palmer: Nomad Cavalry
cards.abilityEnglish: 2 €$, {Spend} Move a Gear from this Legend to an unequipped friendly Unit. If you do, ready that Unit. At the end of your turn, if 5 or more friendly Units and/or Legends are equipped, ready them.
cards.abilityZh: 支付 2 €$ 並【橫置（Spend）】：將此傳奇角色上的一張裝備牌移至一個尚未裝備的友方單位。若如此做，重置該單位。在你的回合結束時，若至少 5 個友方單位或傳奇角色已裝備，重置這些已裝備的角色。

cards.name: Alt Cunningham: Soulkiller Architect
cards.abilityEnglish: {Spend} Your next Program this turn plays for -1 €$ for each friendly min Gig, to a minimum of 1 €$. 1 €$, {Spend} Play a Program from your trash. Bottom-deck it after you play it. (You still pay its cost.)
cards.abilityZh:
【耗用】本回合你打出的下一張程式，我方每有 1 個數值最低的任務，支付費用便減少 1 €$，但最低仍須支付 1 €$。
支付 1 €$ 並【耗用】：從棄牌區打出 1 張程式，結算後將其放到牌庫底部。（仍須支付該程式的費用。）
cards.nameZh: 艾特・坎寧安：靈魂殺手設計者

cards.name: Evelyn Parker: Beautiful Enigma
cards.abilityEnglish: When a friendly CORPO or GANGER Unit steals 1 or more Gigs, ready 1 Eddie. 1 €$, {Spend} A rival Unit must attack next turn if it can.
cards.abilityZh:
當我方企業或幫派成員單位奪取至少 1 個任務時，重置 1 枚歐元籌碼。
支付 1 €$ 並【耗用】：1 個對手單位在下回合若能攻擊，就必須攻擊。
cards.nameZh: 伊芙琳・帕克：美麗謎團

cards.name: Judy Álvarez: Braindance Maestro
cards.abilityEnglish: When you play a BRAINDANCE Program, give a friendly Unit +1 power this turn. {Spend} Trash the top card of your deck. If it's a Program, you may add it to your hand.
cards.abilityZh:
當你打出幻舞程式時，本回合使 1 個我方單位戰力 +1。
【耗用】將牌庫頂端的 1 張牌棄置。若該牌是程式，你可以將其加入手牌。
cards.nameZh: 茱蒂・艾法瑞茲：幻舞大師

cards.name: Wakako Okada: Peace and Harmony
cards.abilityEnglish: {Call} Choose one effect. Give a rival Unit -2 power this turn. // Draw 1. {Spend}: Decrease a Gig by up to 2.
cards.abilityZh:
【呼叫】選擇一項效果：本回合使 1 個對手單位戰力 -2；或抽 1 張牌。
【耗用】使 1 個任務的數值降低最多 2。
cards.nameZh: 岡田和歌子：和平與和諧

cards.name: Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting
cards.abilityEnglish: The first time this Unit wins a fight each turn, ready it. This Unit wins all fights against CORPO Units.
cards.abilityZh: 每回合此單位第一次贏得戰鬥時，將其重置。此單位與具有「企業人員（CORPO）」類別的單位戰鬥時，必定獲勝。
cards.nameZh: 銀手強尼：戰鬥永不止息
cards.errataNoteZh: Beta 標誌性版本誤印 Sell 標記；依官方勘誤，本卡不可出售換取歐元。

cards.name: Adam Smasher: Metal Over Meat
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} Defeat all other Units.
cards.abilityZh: 【打出（Play）】擊敗場上所有其他單位。
cards.nameZh: 亞當・碎骨：鋼鐵凌駕血肉

cards.name: Alt Cunningham: Mother of Daemons
cards.abilityEnglish: When a friendly equipped Unit or Legend is spent, draw 1. When a rival Unit would steal a Gig, you may discard 1 with cost equal to that Gig's value. If you do, the Gig isn't stolen.
cards.abilityZh: 每當一個已裝備的友方單位或傳奇角色橫置時，抽 1 張牌。當對手單位即將奪取任務骰時，你可以棄掉 1 張費用等於該骰點數的牌。若如此做，該任務骰便不會被奪取。
cards.nameZh: 艾特・坎寧安：魔偶之母

cards.name: Hanako Arasaka: In a Gilded Cage
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} Search the top 4 cards of your deck. Reveal any number of cards with cost equal to any friendly Gig values and add them to your hand. Bottom-deck the rest.
cards.abilityZh: 【打出（Play）】查看牌庫頂的 4 張牌。你可以展示任意張費用等於某顆友方任務骰點數的牌，並將它們加入手牌。其餘置於牌庫底。

cards.name: The Relic: Experimental Biochip
cards.abilityEnglish: {Defeated} Play another Unit with cost 9 or less from your trash for free. Then, bottom-deck this Unit.
cards.abilityZh: 【被擊敗（Defeated）】從你的棄牌區免費打出另一張費用為 9 以下的單位牌。然後，將此單位置於牌庫底。

cards.name: Sandayu Oda: Hanako's Guardian
cards.abilityEnglish: {Play} Spend a rival Unit for each friendly value-pair of Gigs. This Unit can attack rival Units the turn it's played.
cards.abilityZh: 【打出】我方每有一組數值相同的任務，便耗用 1 個對手單位。此單位在打出的當回合便可攻擊對手單位。
cards.nameZh: 小田三太夫：華子的護衛

cards.name: Overwatch: Panam's Gift
cards.abilityEnglish: (Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.) {Quick} 1 €$, {Spend} Discard 1. Defeat a spent rival Unit with cost equal to or less than the discarded card's cost.
cards.abilityZh: （裝備至我方單位或正面朝上的傳奇角色。）【快速】支付 1 €$ 並【耗用】：棄掉 1 張手牌。擊敗 1 個已耗用、費用不高於該棄牌費用的對手單位。

cards.name: Rogue Amendiares: Queen of the Afterlife
cards.abilityEnglish: The first time another friendly Unit steals a Gig with value less than its power each turn, ready 2 Eddies. {Quick} 2 €$, {Spend} A rival Unit loses power equal to this Unit's power this turn.
cards.abilityZh: 每回合第一次有另一個我方單位奪取數值低於其戰力的任務時，重置兩枚歐元籌碼。【快速】支付 2 €$ 並【耗用】：本回合使一個對手單位的戰力減少等同此單位戰力的數值。
cards.nameZh: 若惡・阿曼迪亞蕾絲：來生女王

cards.name: Towerfall
cards.abilityEnglish: Choose one effect. If you have less Street Cred than a Rival, choose both instead. Give all rival Units -5 power this turn. // Bottom-deck all rival Units with power 0.
cards.abilityZh: 選擇一項；若你的街頭聲望低於對手，改為兩項都選：本回合所有對手單位戰力 -5；或將所有戰力為 0 的對手單位放到其牌庫底部。

cards.name: Johnny Silverhand: Rocking Renegade
cards.abilityEnglish: 2 €$, {Spend} A friendly Unit can attack spent rival Units the turn it's played. If it's a ROCKER Unit, also give it +2 power this turn. This effect costs -1 €$ for each friendly Gig with 8+ value.
cards.abilityZh: 支付 2 歐元並【橫置】：一個友方單位在打出的當回合，可以攻擊已橫置的對手單位。如果該單位具有「搖滾客（ROCKER）」類別，本回合戰力再 +2。你每控制一顆點數為 8 以上的友方任務骰，此能力的費用便減少 1 歐元。

cards.name: Sasha Yakovleva: Won't Let You Down
cards.abilityEnglish: {Go Solo} {Attack} Reveal the top card of your deck and add it to your hand. This Unit gains power equal to that card's cost this turn. {Defeated} A Rival discards 1.
cards.abilityZh:
【單獨行動】【攻擊】展示牌庫頂端的 1 張牌，並將其加入手牌。本回合此單位獲得等同該牌費用的戰力加成。
【被擊敗】對手棄掉 1 張手牌。
cards.nameZh: 莎夏・雅科夫列娃：絕不讓你失望

cards.name: Panam Palmer: Strength Through Family
cards.abilityEnglish: During your turn, you may Call a Legend for free. {Attack} Discard 1. If you do, draw 1 for each friendly face-up Legend.
cards.abilityZh: 在你的回合中，你可以免費呼叫一名傳奇角色。【攻擊】棄掉 1 張牌。若如此做，每有一名我方正面朝上的傳奇角色，便抽 1 張牌。
cards.nameZh: 帕娜・帕瑪：家族的力量

cards.name: Judy Álvarez: Nothing to Doubt
cards.abilityEnglish: 1 €$, {Spend} Reveal the top card of your deck. You may play it for free. Otherwise, add it to your hand.
cards.abilityZh: 支付 1 €$ 並【耗用】：展示牌庫頂端的 1 張牌。你可以免費打出該牌；若不打出，則將其加入手牌。
cards.nameZh: 茱蒂・艾法瑞茲：無庸置疑

cards.name: Yorinobu Arasaka: Embracing Destruction
cards.abilityEnglish: The first time a friendly ARASAKA Unit attacks each turn, draw 1. Then, if you have less than 20 ☆ (Street Cred), discard 1.
cards.abilityZh: 每回合第一次有我方「荒坂」單位攻擊時，抽 1 張牌。然後，若你的街頭聲望低於 20，棄掉 1 張牌。

cards.name: Viktor Vektor: Sit Down and Relax
cards.abilityEnglish: {Call} Search the top 5 cards of your deck. Reveal up to 2 Gears with cost 2 or less and add them to your hand. Bottom-deck the rest in a random order.
cards.abilityZh: 【呼叫（Call）】查看牌庫頂的 5 張牌，展示其中最多 2 張費用為 2 以下的裝備牌，並加入手牌。其餘以隨機順序放到牌庫底。
cards.nameZh: 維克・威科特：坐下來放輕鬆

cards.name: Goro Takemura: Hands Unclean
cards.abilityEnglish: {Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.) {Blocker} (You may spend this Unit to redirect a rival Unit's attack to it instead.)
cards.abilityZh: 【單獨行動（Go Solo）】支付此傳奇角色的費用，將其作為已重置的單位打出。此回合即可攻擊；離場時將其移出遊戲。【阻擋者（Blocker）】你可以耗用此單位，將對手單位的攻擊改為攻擊此單位。

cards.name: Saburo Arasaka: Stubborn Patriarch
cards.abilityEnglish: Friendly ARASAKA Units have +1 power while attacking. (Units steal an extra Gig for every 10 power.)
cards.abilityZh: 我方「荒坂」單位攻擊時，戰力 +1。（單位每有 10 點戰力，就能額外奪取 1 個任務。）

cards.name: Jackie Welles: Pour One Out For Me
cards.abilityEnglish: The first time you play a Blue Unit or Blue Gear each turn, you may decrease a friendly Gig by up to 2. If it becomes a min Gig, draw 1.
cards.abilityZh: 每回合第一次打出藍色單位或藍色裝備時，你可以將 1 個我方任務的點數降低最多 2。若該任務因此變為最低點數任務，抽 1 張牌。
cards.nameZh: 阿傑・威爾斯：敬我一杯

cards.name: V: Corporate Exile
cards.abilityEnglish: {Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. When it leaves the field, remove it from the game.)
cards.abilityZh: 【單獨行動（Go Solo）】支付此傳奇角色的費用，將其作為已重置的單位打出。此回合即可攻擊；離場時將其移出遊戲。
